question: Who among the following cricketers won the 2019 Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy for the ICC Player of the Year, announced in January 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ben Stokes**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ben Stokes** of **England** won the 2019 **Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy** for the** ICC Player of the Year**.
 
• **Pat Cummins **of **Australia **won the **Test player of the year**.
 
• **Rohit Sharma** won **ODI player of the year**.
 
• An honorary Spirit of Cricket Award was given to Virat Kohli.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sir Garfield Sobers Trophy is a cricket trophy awarded to an ICC men's Cricketer annually by the** International Cricket Council.**
 
• The trophy is named after the famous former West Indies cricket captain Sir Garfield Sobers.
